seo.description: Cryocans and liquid nitrogen containers for safe storage and transport of LN₂. Vacuum insulated. Supplied from Nagpur.

about: Liquid nitrogen containers (cryocans and dewars) are vacuum-insulated vessels for storing and transporting LN₂ in small quantities. Losses depend on size and insulation, so choose a size that matches how quickly you use the liquid.
Containers must never be sealed airtight; their caps and necks are designed to vent boil-off.

faq.question: Can I refill my own liquid nitrogen container?
faq.answer: Call or WhatsApp us with your container’s make and capacity and we will confirm whether we can refill it.

faq.question: Why must a liquid nitrogen container never be sealed?
faq.answer: Liquid nitrogen constantly boils off into gas. A sealed container would build up pressure and could burst.
